description: Return one stored product of one indexed shop, chosen by the shop's origin (https://shop.example, or any page URL on it) and the product's permalink, or its sku where the catalog shows one. The answer is the same JSON as that product's entry in GET /catalog/shop/products.json?origin=<origin>: name, price, currency, stock, link and when the catalog read it. Stored data only: nothing is fetched. An unknown shop or product is refused by name.

origin.description: The shop's origin or a page URL on it (http or https).

permalink.description: The product page URL, exactly as the catalog lists it.

sku.description: The product's sku, where the catalog's entry shows one.

name: catalog.get_product
title: Get one product
